_about: Darts in the club's games room (polish1 item 71, core/darts_rules.gd, game/darts_game.gd). board = ring radii in mm (standard board). ai = the house players: sigma = scatter of a throw in mm (normal in x and y), think = seconds before each dart. aim = the player's throw: sway = how far the aim drifts in mm, steady = how much holding the steady key calms it (share), steady_seconds before the hand shakes, shake = the drift then, spread = a little scatter on every throw in mm. stakes = the chips a game against the house can be played for (win = the stake again). distance_m = the throw line from the board (2.37 m). clock_skip = in Around the Clock a double of your number moves you on two, a treble three. boards = where the boards hang in the games room: the bull's position from the club centre (m) and the yaw the board faces (90 = east, into the room).
